words.definition_en: full of happiness and joy; causing happiness.
words.sentence_en: The wedding was a joyous occasion for both families.
words.sentence_tw: 這場婚禮對兩個家庭來說都是個令人愉快的場合。
words.analysis: 形容詞，用來描述令人充滿喜悅與歡樂的事情、節慶或場合。
words.timing: 描繪慶典、佳節、婚禮或令人心滿意足的歡樂事件時。

words.definition_en: go somewhere with (someone) as a companion or escort.
words.sentence_en: Children must be accompanied by an adult at the swimming pool.
words.sentence_tw: 兒童在游泳池必須有大人陪伴。
words.analysis: 及物動詞，常用被動語態 be accompanied by ...，也可指音樂上的伴奏。
words.timing: 描述陪伴他人前往某處、結伴同行或樂器伴奏時。

words.definition_en: absolutely necessary; extremely important.
words.sentence_en: Good communication is essential for a healthy relationship.
words.sentence_tw: 良好的溝通對於健康的關係來說是不可或缺的。
words.analysis: 表示極度重要且不可或缺的本質要素。常用句型為 It is essential to V / that...
words.timing: 強調核心要素、必備條件或說明某事極其重要時。

words.definition_en: an abstract idea; a general notion.
words.sentence_en: The teacher used simple examples to explain the complex concept.
words.sentence_tw: 老師用簡單的例子來解釋這個複雜的概念。
words.analysis: 可數名詞，指經過思考歸納出的抽象想法、觀念或理論架構。
words.timing: 說明學術理論、設計理念、抽象想法或新思維時。

words.definition_en: feel or show deep sorrow or regret for someone who has died or something that has been lost.
words.sentence_en: The whole nation mourned the death of the respected leader.
words.sentence_tw: 舉國上下都在哀悼這位受人尊敬的領袖的逝世。
words.analysis: 指因他人過世或重大失去而感受並表達深沉的悲傷哀痛。
words.timing: 描述悼念逝者、追思活動或表達沉痛哀傷時。

words.definition_en: a feeling of deep distress caused by loss, disappointment, or other misfortune.
words.sentence_en: Time can gradually heal the deep sorrow in one's heart.
words.sentence_tw: 時間能漸漸撫平內心深處的悲傷。
words.analysis: 感情色彩強烈的名詞，指因失落、不幸或不幸遭遇引發的深層悲痛。
words.timing: 描繪喪親之痛、重大打擊或文學作品中的傷感氛圍時。

words.definition_en: a particular time or instance of an event; a special event.
words.sentence_en: He wore a formal suit for the special occasion.
words.sentence_tw: 他在這個特殊的場合穿了一身正式西裝。
words.analysis: 指特定時刻或特殊活動場合。形容詞形為 occasional（偶爾的）。
words.timing: 討論慶典儀式、正式活動場合或特殊時機時。

words.definition_en: the act of coming together again after being separated.
words.sentence_en: Lunar New Year is an important time for family reunion.
words.sentence_tw: 農曆新年是家庭團聚的重要時節。
words.analysis: 指久別後的重逢聚會，如家族團聚或校友同學會。
words.timing: 描述年節團圓、同學會聚首或久別重逢的溫馨時刻時。

words.definition_en: regard as probable; expect or look forward to.
words.sentence_en: The fans eagerly anticipated the release of the new movie.
words.sentence_tw: 影迷們熱切期盼著這部新電影的上映。
words.analysis: 及物動詞，著重於預期某事發生並懷抱期待預先做出準備。
words.timing: 表達對未來的熱切期待、預測趨勢或預先規劃時。

words.definition_en: the action or process of arriving.
words.sentence_en: We are waiting for the arrival of the flight.
words.sentence_tw: 我們正在等待班機的到達。
words.analysis: 動詞 arrive 的名詞形，指人、班機或新時代的到來。
words.timing: 討論班機抵達、嘉賓到場或季節/新時代降臨時。

words.definition_en: make (something) look more attractive by adding extra items to it.
collocations: decorate A with B（用 B 裝飾 A）
words.sentence_en: They decorated the Christmas tree with colorful lights.
words.sentence_tw: 他們用五彩斑爛的燈飾裝飾聖誕樹。
words.analysis: 常用於 decorate A with B，表示用飾品美化空間或物品。
words.timing: 描述節慶佈置、房間裝潢或點綴物品時。

words.definition_en: a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.
words.sentence_en: Everyone has a different preference when it comes to music.
words.sentence_tw: 當談到音樂時，每個人都有不同的偏好。
words.analysis: 動詞 prefer 的名詞形，指在多個選項中更喜歡某一個。
words.timing: 表達個人飲食、音樂、選擇偏好或意見調查時。

words.definition_en: a formal party to receive and entertain guests; the act of receiving.
words.sentence_en: A warm reception was held to welcome the international guests.
words.sentence_tw: 舉辦了一場熱烈的款待會來歡迎國際貴賓。
words.analysis: 可指正式的款待茶會/婚宴，也可指飯店大廳接待處或訊號接收情況。
words.timing: 描述婚宴宴席、外賓接待茶會或櫃檯接待時。

words.definition_en: a large meal, typically one in celebration of something; eat heartily.
words.sentence_en: The guests feasted on delicious seafood at the party.
words.sentence_tw: 賓客們在派對上盡情享用美味的海鮮。
words.analysis: 作名詞指豐盛盛宴；作動詞搭配 feast on 表大快朵頤或飽覽眼福。
words.timing: 描述節慶豐盛大餐、大快朵頤或視覺饗宴時。

words.definition_en: the first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise.
collocations: from dawn to dusk（從早到晚）
words.sentence_en: The farmers woke up at dawn to start their work in the fields.
words.sentence_tw: 農夫們在黎明時分醒來，開始在田裡工作。
words.analysis: 指清晨天剛亮之際，也可比喻開端或曙光（the dawn of a new era）。
words.timing: 描述清晨天光、晨起作息或新時代開端時。

words.definition_en: make a thorough or dramatic change in the form, appearance, or character of.
collocations: transform A into B（將 A 轉變為 B）
words.sentence_en: The new technology completely transformed the industry.
words.sentence_tw: 這項新科技徹底改變了這個產業。
words.analysis: 著重於劇烈、徹底的形態、性格或結構上的重大轉變。
words.timing: 描述產業轉型、環境改造、個人大幅蛻變時。

words.definition_en: have a similar appearance or qualities in common with (someone or something).
words.sentence_en: The little boy strongly resembles his father.
words.sentence_tw: 這個小男孩看起來非常像他的父親。
words.analysis: 及物動詞，不可用於進行式或被動語態，直接接賓語 (resemble sb.)。
words.timing: 描繪外貌相似、性格神似或物體輪廓相近時。

words.definition_en: take part in an action or event.
words.sentence_en: All students are encouraged to participate in school activities.
words.sentence_tw: 鼓勵所有學生積極參加學校活動。
words.analysis: 不及物動詞，核心句型為 participate in，強調主動投身參與其中。
words.timing: 討論活動報名、課堂參與、競賽或社會運動時。

words.definition_en: tease or laugh at in a scornful or contemptuous manner; not authentic or real.
words.sentence_en: They conducted a mock exam to help students prepare for the real test.
words.sentence_tw: 他們舉行了一次模擬考試（虛假考試），以幫助學生準備真正的測驗。
words.analysis: 作動詞表嘲弄嘲笑；作形容詞表模擬的、假裝的（如 mock exam 模擬考）。
words.timing: 描述嘲諷舉止，或指演練/模擬性質的活動時。

words.definition_en: identify (someone or something) from having encountered them before; acknowledge.
words.sentence_en: I was so surprised that he recognized me after all these years.
words.sentence_tw: 我很驚訝在這麼多年後他竟然還認得我。
words.analysis: 可指辨認出久未見面的人物，也可指官方/社會認可或承認。
words.timing: 描述久別重逢辨認、成就獲得認可或官方承認地位時。

words.definition_en: certain to happen; unavoidable.
words.sentence_en: Change is an inevitable part of life.
words.sentence_tw: 改變是生活中不可避免的一部分。
words.analysis: 形容客觀規律或必然趨勢，無法迴避或阻擋。
words.timing: 討論自然規律、歷史趨勢或無法避免的結果時。

words.definition_en: a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order.
words.sentence_en: The water cycle is an essential process for Earth's climate.
words.sentence_tw: 水循環是地球氣候不可或缺的過程。
words.analysis: 指周而復始、定期循環往復的過程或週期。
words.timing: 討論自然界循環（水/碳循環）、經濟週期或習慣循環時。

words.definition_en: occurring once every year.
words.sentence_en: The company holds its annual meeting every December.
words.sentence_tw: 這家公司每年十二月都會舉行年度會議。
words.analysis: 形容一年一度、每年固定舉辦一次的事情。
words.timing: 描述年度報告、年度盛會或一年一度的節慶時。

words.definition_en: wait for (an event, a person, or an outcome).
words.comparison: await + N (及物) vs. wait for + N (不及物)
words.sentence_en: A bright future awaits the hardworking students.
words.sentence_tw: 光明的未來在等待著勤奮的學生們。
words.analysis: 及物動詞，後面直接接賓語（await response/arrival），較 wait for 正式。
words.timing: 描述靜候結果、等待消息或比喻光明前景在前方時。

words.definition_en: break free from confinement or control; avoid something dangerous.
collocations: narrow escape（死裡逃生/僥倖逃脫）
words.sentence_en: They were lucky to escape from the burning building without injury.
words.sentence_tw: 他們幸運地從起火的大樓中逃脫而沒有受傷。
words.analysis: 可指從危險場所逃跑，也可指避開不好的處境。
words.timing: 描述災害逃生、避開危險或擺脫困境時。

phrases.sentence_en: The loud noise outside scared the little cat to death.
phrases.sentence_tw: 外面巨大的噪音把那隻小貓嚇得要命。
phrases.analysis: 誇飾語氣片語，用來極力形容受驚嚇的程度。

phrases.phrase: make one's hair stand on end
phrases.sentence_en: The terrifying ghost story made everyone's hair stand on end.
phrases.sentence_tw: 這個可怕的鬼故事讓所有人毛骨悚然。
phrases.analysis: 生動的比喻，形容因極度恐懼而頭皮發麻、毛髮直豎。

phrases.definition_tw: 紀念（作為對……的尊敬或感謝）
phrases.sentence_en: The monument was built in honor of the fallen soldiers.
phrases.sentence_tw: 這座紀念碑是為了紀念陣亡的士兵而建的。
phrases.analysis: 表達崇高敬意、紀念偉人或重大事件時使用。

phrases.sentence_en: You should book the hotel tickets well in advance.
phrases.sentence_tw: 你應該提早預訂飯店房間。
phrases.analysis: 時間副詞片語，強調在事件發生前預先完成準備。

phrases.sentence_en: Many ancient traditions are gradually dying out in modern society.
phrases.sentence_tw: 許多古老的傳統在現代社會中正在逐漸消失。
phrases.analysis: 可用於物種滅絕、習俗淡忘或火勢/風浪漸趨平息。
